sources.title: SPIFFE X509-SVID specification
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: IAM Roles Anywhere：憑證屬性映射與信任錨限定
related.titleEn: IAM Roles Anywhere: certificate attribute mapping and trust-anchor scoping
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：格式錯誤樣本均拒絕，兩個餘裕可重算；驗收必須同時具備正確身分、有效鏈結與確實採用的新序號。 交付svid-validation.csv、序號切換時間線、70秒延遲案例及回復判據；公開資料只含合成序號與URI。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Reject every malformed fixture and reproduce both margins. Acceptance requires the correct identity, valid chain and evidence that the replacement serial is actually active. Deliver svid-validation.csv, the serial-switch timeline, delayed 70-second-margin case and rollback criteria. Public evidence contains synthetic serials and URIs only.
related.difference: 以十份合成憑證描述檔列trust anchor、issuer CN、subject OU及映射後標籤；寫出需要指定錨及指定OU的政策表，保留缺值為缺值。
related.differenceEn: Tabulate trust anchor, issuer CN, subject OU and mapped tags for ten synthetic certificate descriptors. Define required anchor and OU conditions, explicitly preserving absent values.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 完成標準鏈結驗證仍不代表SVID專屬檢查通過；時間餘裕只衡量已驗證的新憑證能否在舊證到期前被應用採用。 舊證在t=900秒到期，新證t=620可用，驗證與reload共需70秒；延遲案例把新證可用時間改成760秒。 餘裕900−620−70=210秒；延遲後900−760−70=70秒。格式不合格時兩個正餘裕都不能當作允許理由。

本課兩個profile皆採固定AND條件：指定錨ArnEquals、OU StringEquals、CN StringEquals。缺少CN使這個StringEquals條件不成立；此結論不能推廣到StringNotEquals等其他IAM運算子。 十筆中8筆符合錨限制，6筆同時具有正確OU與CN標籤；這6筆中的2筆使用profile-A、4筆使用profile-B。變更僅移除profile-A的issuerCN映射，兩個profile的政策條件完全不變。 原始通過率6/10×100=60%；缺少所需映射後4/10×100=40%。這是固定fixture覆蓋統計，不是AWS實際允許率。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Passing ordinary certificate-path validation does not imply the SVID-specific checks pass. Timing margin measures whether an already validated replacement can be adopted before the old credential expires. The old credential expires at t=900 seconds; its replacement is available at 620 and validation plus reload takes 70 seconds. A delayed fixture changes replacement availability to 760. Margin is 900−620−70=210 seconds, falling to 70 with delayed availability. Neither positive margin authorizes a replacement that fails identity or leaf-format validation.

Both profiles use fixed AND conditions: the designated anchor with ArnEquals, plus OU and CN with StringEquals. Missing CN makes this selected equality condition fail. Do not generalize that behavior to StringNotEquals or every IAM operator. Eight of ten rows pass anchor restrictions and six also have correct OU and CN tags. Two of these six use profile-A and four use profile-B. Only profile-A loses its issuerCN mapping; policy conditions remain fixed for both profiles. Baseline fixture pass rate is 6/10×100=60%; the changed mapping gives 4/10×100=40%. These are local test outcomes, not an observed AWS authorization rate.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: TLS憑證壓縮：協商、長度宣告與解壓上限
related.titleEn: TLS certificate compression: negotiation and decompression bounds
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：格式錯誤樣本均拒絕，兩個餘裕可重算；驗收必須同時具備正確身分、有效鏈結與確實採用的新序號。 交付svid-validation.csv、序號切換時間線、70秒延遲案例及回復判據；公開資料只含合成序號與URI。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Reject every malformed fixture and reproduce both margins. Acceptance requires the correct identity, valid chain and evidence that the replacement serial is actually active. Deliver svid-validation.csv, the serial-switch timeline, delayed 70-second-margin case and rollback criteria. Public evidence contains synthetic serials and URIs only.
related.difference: 建立支援演算法、未支援演算法、長度不符及超出本地上限四個封包描述；所有內容採本地生成文字，不下載未知壓縮包。
related.differenceEn: Prepare descriptors for a supported algorithm, unsupported algorithm, length mismatch and local-limit overflow. Use locally generated inert text; never download an unknown compressed payload merely to test decompression behavior.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 完成標準鏈結驗證仍不代表SVID專屬檢查通過；時間餘裕只衡量已驗證的新憑證能否在舊證到期前被應用採用。 舊證在t=900秒到期，新證t=620可用，驗證與reload共需70秒；延遲案例把新證可用時間改成760秒。 餘裕900−620−70=210秒；延遲後900−760−70=70秒。格式不合格時兩個正餘裕都不能當作允許理由。
解壓後須與宣告未壓縮長度一致；本課另設16000位元組資源上限，計算輸出相對輸入的放大率。此上限是實驗選擇，不是RFC固定最大值。 壓縮輸入2400位元組，宣告及實際輸出皆12000位元組；記錄演算法識別、客戶端廣告清單及解壓終止原因。 放大率12000/2400=5倍；維持輸入而輸出改14400位元組時為6倍，兩者都仍低於16000位元組本地上限。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Passing ordinary certificate-path validation does not imply the SVID-specific checks pass. Timing margin measures whether an already validated replacement can be adopted before the old credential expires. The old credential expires at t=900 seconds; its replacement is available at 620 and validation plus reload takes 70 seconds. A delayed fixture changes replacement availability to 760. Margin is 900−620−70=210 seconds, falling to 70 with delayed availability. Neither positive margin authorizes a replacement that fails identity or leaf-format validation.

Decompressed size must agree with the declared uncompressed length. The exercise additionally selects a 16000-byte resource limit and measures output-to-input expansion; this local limit is not presented as a fixed RFC maximum. Use a 2400-byte compressed input with both declared and actual output of 12000 bytes. Record algorithm identifier, the client advertisement and termination reason so that negotiation failure cannot be mistaken for decompressor failure. Expansion is 12000/2400=5 times. Holding input size fixed while changing output to 14400 gives 6 times; both remain below the local byte limit, but neither ratio proves the reconstructed certificate is trusted.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
